description:
KCS 0.3.0's re-validation — the cheapest item on the promotability ladder after KGP, and unowned.

WHY IT IS CHEAP. Per docs/reference/promotability.md: 'a re-validation, no fold... The 0.3.0 change was additive and backward-compatible against a scenario that exists and whose encoding runs. This is a read-and-confirm pass, and nobody owns it.'

THE SNAG THAT MAKES IT NOT TRIVIAL — DR-10. 'the downstream §5 vocabulary has no `structure_matches`, which is the predicate the 0.3.0 fold IS, so the re-validation cannot be discharged by a machine replay of that clause — a hand-walk still can, and the drift is downstream work either way.' So the fold's own predicate is missing from the downstream vocabulary: the one clause this version added is exactly the one a replay cannot check.

SCOPE. The re-validation and KCS's own status. The downstream vocabulary drift is named, not fixed here — it belongs to whoever owns that vocabulary, and this tasklist's job is to state it rather than absorb it.

userStories.title: The re-validation is walked, with the 0.3.0 clause hand-checked
acceptanceCriteria: The 0.3.0 determinism fold (delta Q: `structure_matches` and the stability rules it carries) is re-validated against the existing scenario, with the `structure_matches` clause HAND-walked because DR-10 makes a machine replay of it impossible.

The rest of the pass may lean on the running encoding, and the record says which parts were replayed and which were hand-walked. Mixing the two silently is how a green replay gets read as a full verdict — the same failure DR-7 and DR-8 record against KCB.

userStories.title: KCS's status moves only on a clean pass, and DR-10 is stated as downstream
acceptanceCriteria: IF the re-validation is clean: `specs/conformance-scenario.md` moves to **ratified**, with the walk named in a changelog entry. Note KCS was grandfathered under the previous rule at 0.2.0 — say what standard this promotion is under.

DR-10 is recorded in `docs/reference/promotability.md` as DOWNSTREAM work with an owner named or explicitly unowned. It must not be closed here by editing the downstream vocabulary from this repo — koine specifies, and the vocabulary lives with its implementation.
IF the pass is not clean, the status does not move and the blocker is named. A read-and-confirm that confirms nothing is a legitimate outcome.
